name: UIFakeLight
src_typeComment: The Screen Space Overlay equivalent of FakeLight's PerPixel mode — a SEPARATE tool, not a variant of the 3D FakeLight, because overlay UI has no 3D world position at all to sample. Publishes real SCREEN-PIXEL coordinates into a shared global array every frame (same "global array" technique as FakeLight/ GrassBendEmitter/RippleEmitter), sampled by Toolkit/UI/Fake Light Receiver via UIFakeLightOverlayInclude.cginc's SampleUIFakeLights(). Point and Spot both supported.  Place this on a RectTransform under a Screen Space - Overlay canvas — its own .position IS the real screen-pixel position for that render mode (Unity's own convention, the same one RectTransformUtility.WorldToScreenPoint relies on), so no camera/projection math is needed here.

src_serialized.name: spotAngle
src_serialized.tooltip: Full cone angle in degrees. Only used when Type is Spot. The cone points along this RectTransform's local +X axis — rotate the RectTransform (its Z rotation) to aim it.
